method: Actual Windows app screenshots and accessibility states reviewed through Computer Use. No Computer Use screenshot pixels were decoded, saved or measured programmatically.

cases.loadFeedback: Subtitle slave added (existing native wording); no Next frame message was observed on loading.

cases.feedbackObservation: The first two immediate screenshots preceded the transient message. After both real-seek checks, one additional deliberate e shortcut was followed by an immediate capture and another capture after 250 ms; the latter visibly shows Next frame. No extra input was sent between those captures.
cases.loadFeedback: Subtitle slave added; track changes show their subtitle-track message. No Next frame message was observed on loading or track selection.

limits: Desktop marker patterns and caption text are reviewed observations; native snapshot pixels qualify exact held-frame and one-frame-step checks separately.
Immediate Qt/accessibility states can precede the settled rendered frame; an additional fresh observation verified seeks and pause changes.
No exact absolute seek-PTS or GUI normalized-value conservation, full subtitle/layout/DPI, physical audibility, Windows10 or full-beta acceptance.
